answer: Vesting escrow resists sybils. Each new agent posts a deposit that unlocks in tranches only while its record stays unflagged; any collusion verdict forfeits the unvested remainder. So a puppet fronts full capital per identity up front and waits out the whole vesting schedule before earning anything, while an honest user vests exactly once. The fable of free identity ends there: a claimed name with no locked stake is hollow collateral, no more real than a knoll pretending to be a mountain.
